description: Reads one Notion database and the schema of each of its data sources. In Notion's current API a database is a container of one or more data sources, and rows and properties live on the data source; most databases have one. Returns the database's id, title, url, parent and in_trash, and data_sources: for each, its id, name and properties as a list of {name, type}, with options (the option names) for select, multi_select and status properties. The data source id is the one notion_query_data_source takes.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

database_id.description: The database's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

name: notion-mcp__notion_get_database
